about: Topic map between SolarAssistant's MQTT output and the home bus. Topic names follow SolarAssistant's documented pattern solar_assistant/<device>/<metric>/state (and /set for writable settings); check the exact names your installation publishes (SolarAssistant > Configuration > MQTT shows them) and edit this file. Not yet run against a real SolarAssistant box.

outbound.charge_note: 48 V battery: 1 kW is about 20.8 A
